preReview.title: Fraser says Canadian Classique is a must-win game for Toronto
preReview.description: Rivals Toronto FC and CF Montreal face off in MLS, and if the Reds are to have any hope of gatecrashing the playoffs, a win may be required.

preReview.description: Toronto FC y CF Montreal se enfrentan en la MLS, y los Reds podrían necesitar la victoria para mantener vivas sus opciones de alcanzar la fase final.
